changed.headline: Because of AutoWeed AI spot spraying, sugarcane field trials in reef catchments used 35% less herbicide than broadcast spraying at 97% weed efficacy.
Because of Retail Insight's AI markdown system, Central Co-op says it avoided 8,796 tonnes of food waste and sold 32,449,817 reduced-to-clear items across its stores.
Because of Kisan-eMitra's AI upgrade, India's PM-KISAN chatbot answered 2.69 million farmer queries in 186 days, a 668% increase over manual grievance handling, Wadhwani AI says.
Because of Zest's AI surplus-matching, a UK consortium redistributed 201.9 tonnes of Nestlé factory surplus to charities, supporting an estimated 94,133 people.
Because of an AI-based smart fish feeder, small-scale tilapia farmers in Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia cut manual feeding time by 70% and feed waste by 20%, SEARCA reports.
Because of an AI chatbot on its webchat, the DVLA says average handling time fell from 8 minutes to 2 minutes 30 seconds and 25% to 30% of queries needed no adviser.

Because AI-assisted transcripts could be produced within minutes, Indiana's Marion County expedited mental-health appeals pilot reached a Court of Appeals opinion in an average of 30.85 days, against 143.3 days in 2023.
Because of PlanAssist, an AI tool for planning officers, England's housing ministry says early testing in three councils cut time spent on key planning tasks by 58%.
Because of a Copilot Studio chatbot, Westminster City Council says its chatbot handled 33,400 resident queries since September 2025, resolving 89.5% without a human agent.

Because of AI, medical laboratory technologists at a Chinese teaching hospital who trained for two weeks on an AI platform with real-time probability feedback scored higher on a blood cell morphology test than colleagues who used textbooks and atlases, in a randomised study of 52 technologists.

AI-assisted colonoscopy did not significantly raise the adenoma detection rate (66.6% vs 61.0%) among 914 Italian screening-programme patients undergoing surveillance colonoscopy, and lengthened withdrawal time.
AI-guided wearable monitoring after heart-failure discharge at five Veterans Affairs hospitals did not significantly cut heart-failure rehospitalization (16.3% vs 18.7%) compared with standard care.

An AI-driven decision-support prompt for anesthesia teams caring for 7,294 surgical patients with cognitive impairment at Mount Sinai did not significantly change postoperative delirium (35.1% vs 32.7%) or adherence to best practices.
